# Vendored Rapier Physics

This folder contains the static browser runtime for `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat`.

- Package: `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat`
- Version: `0.19.3`
- Source: npm package fetched with `npm pack @dimforge/rapier3d-compat`
- Upstream: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier.js
- License: Apache-2.0, as declared in `package.json`

The project uses this vendored copy so the HTML prototype can run from a static local server without a runtime CDN dependency. The adapter layer lives in `src/physics-world.js`.
